composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. creative_direction: Build a turtle with a flattened polished-granite shell and short blue-green glazed-clay legs. Extend the small head slightly, giving it patient friendly eyes and a restrained mouth. Keep the stone speckles sparse enough to preserve the large shell shape. Warm low light and a pale gray background distinguish the weighty pebble from the softer ceramic body. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
